_readme: Synthetic, labelled feature vectors for scenarios 9-14 of docs/ml/ABUSE_SCENARIO_CATALOGUE.md (scenarios 1-8 already have executable specs in scoring.service.spec.ts and don't need duplicating here). Feature names match the rule-engine fact names used elsewhere in this codebase (see src/risk/rule-engine) so Phase 4's training pipeline can reuse the same feature-extraction code path as the live rule engine, not a parallel one. This is synthetic data authored for MVP scaffolding, not real customer traffic — see the catalogue doc's 'Known limitation' section before using this for anything beyond training-pipeline development.
